Four purified native subunits, including the126aa HndB, correspond exactly to U07229 translations and reviewed Q46505..Q46508. Historical NADP product names do not define substrate specificity. Reverse physiological H2 production and all possible NADP side reactions are not inferred from the forward assay.

Six purified native subunit types identified by MS, corresponding to MOTHE_c19180..MOTHE_c19230 in DSM521 CP012369. HydD/E/F are physical electron-transfer/accessory subunits, not HydEFG maturation enzymes by name; HydF lacks the H-cluster and is not catalytic. Sequence-predicted FeS cluster counts are not atomic truth. No DMSO respiration or structural explanation of specificity is assigned.
